items.title: Lf^*Rf_*Q = Q for Q supported on f^{-1}Z when f is an isomorphism over Z and flat along it
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-pushouts.tex (Pushouts of Algebraic Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces-pushouts.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Stalk computation at y-bar: away from f^{-1}Z both sides vanish; over Z use the stalk-pushforward-with-support lemma to get (Rf_*Q)_x = Q_y, flat base change to move the pullback inside, and reduce to Q_y ⊗ O_y ≅ Q_y in the derived category; the cohomology modules are I-power torsion (stalk-of-module-with-support), the flat local ring map O_x -> O_y is an isomorphism mod I (f^{-1}Z -> Z an isomorphism) and finitely generated I, so the neighbourhood-isomorphism lemma identifies the cohomology of the tensor with that of Q.
